run_fast_rcnn_inference: run fast_rcnn_inference to apply NMS and score thresholding on predicted boxes and scores for a batch of images
build_FastRCNNOutputLayers: build a FastRCNNOutputLayers module with configurable classification and box regression heads for object detection
run_FastRCNNOutputLayers_forward: run the forward pass of FastRCNNOutputLayers to get class scores and box regression deltas from ROI features
run_FastRCNNOutputLayers_losses: run the losses method of FastRCNNOutputLayers to compute classification and box regression loss during training
run_FastRCNNOutputLayers_inference: run inference with FastRCNNOutputLayers to produce final detection results from proposals and predictions
